# OfferSteady
> OfferSteady is an English AI interview assistant for preparation, live transcription, grounded answer guidance, user-triggered screenshot questions, written assessments, and interview review.

## Responsible use
- AI output is guidance, not a hiring guarantee.
- Users must verify every claim and answer from their real experience.
- Users must follow the interview organiser's rules for recording, confidentiality, screen capture, and AI assistance.

Support: contact@oneshowailab.com
